items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: my father used to love the Ellington quote there’s only two kinds of music, good and bad.

ctx.x: Yeah. Freaky stuff. And my mother was a world renown flamenco dancer. So you know I grew up in a culturally very rich household. Twenty years ago I took her to Spain and they’d stop flamenco performances and say, “Ladies and Gentlemen, please we have” — so there was gypsies around the house. My father used to turn his violin over and jam with flamenco guitarists you know who couldn’t read music. So there was always this very rich, the flamenco, the Spanish people describe something called duende, which is kind of…

Do you ever have a situation like someone wants a jingle and someone comes in and like, “Okay we want it to go like ‘It’s turkey time at Cumberland Farms’” and you have to do something with that idea?
